Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Lists catalog records; llist prints every field of each record. \`limit=\` and \`offset=\` page through the result, \`current\` limits to records of configured resources, \`enabled\`/\`disabled\` to resources in that state.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit=` | integer |  |  |  | Most rows. |
| `offset=` | integer |  |  |  | Rows to skip. |
| `current` | keyword |  |  |  | Only configured resources. |
| `enabled` | keyword |  |  | one of: state | Only enabled. |
| `disabled` | keyword |  |  | one of: state | Only disabled. |
| `catalog=` | resource | from [`.catalogs`](../dot-catalogs/) |  |  | Catalog name. |

These arguments apply to every subcommand as well.

## Subcommands

### list basefiles {#sub-list-basefiles}

**Base files of a job.**

Lists the base files of a job that used a Base job, that is the files taken over from the base backup instead of being saved again; jobid= or ujobid= is required.

```text
list basefiles [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current]
               [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>] [jobid=<jobid>]
               [ujobid=<ujobid>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The base files referenced by job 42:

```text
list basefiles jobid=42
```

### list backups {#sub-list-backups}

**Backups of a client.**

Lists the backups of one client; client= is required. fileset= limits the listing to one FileSet, fileset=any includes all of them. jobstatus=, level=, days= and hours= filter as with list jobs, order=asc or order=desc sorts by start time; any other order value is an error.

Without client= the reply is "missing parameter: client". A FileSet outside the FileSet ACL of the console gives "Access to specified FileSet not allowed."

```text
list backups [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
             [catalog=<catalog>] client=<client> [fileset=<fileset>]
             [jobstatus=<jobstatus>] [level=<F|I|D>[,...]]
             [order=<asc|desc|ascending|descending>] [days=<days>]
             [hours=<hours>] [reverse]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  | required | Client name. |
| `fileset=` | resource | from [`.filesets`](../dot-filesets/) |  |  | FileSet name. |
| `jobstatus=` | string |  |  |  | Job status letters. |
| `level=` | enum | `F`, `I`, `D` |  | list | Level. |
| `order=` | enum | `asc`, `desc`, `ascending`, `descending` |  |  | Sort order. |
| `days=` | integer |  |  |  | Of the last days. |
| `hours=` | integer |  |  |  | Of the last hours. |
| `reverse` | keyword |  |  |  | Newest first. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The five newest backups of bareos-fd:

```text
list backups client=bareos-fd fileset=any order=desc limit=5
```

The full backups of bareos-fd:

```text
list backups client=bareos-fd level=Full
```

The catalog record of bareos-fd:


### list clients {#sub-list-clients}

**Every client.**

Lists every client record of the catalog with id, name, file retention and job retention; llist adds the uname and autoprune setting. enabled or disabled keep only clients in that state in the configuration, current only clients still configured.

```text
list clients [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
             [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

All clients of the catalog:

```text
list clients
```

Clients disabled in the configuration:

```text
list clients disabled
```

**Copies of jobs.**

```text
list copies [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
            [catalog=<catalog>] [jobid=<jobid>[,...]]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  | list | Job ID. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

All copy jobs of the catalog:

```text
list copies
```

The copies of jobs 42 and 43:

```text
list copies jobid=42,43
```

### list files {#sub-list-files}

**Files of a job.**

Lists the paths of all files saved by one job, including the base files it refers to; jobid= or ujobid= is required. limit= and offset= do not shorten the text listing, they only appear in the range information of API mode 2.

```text
list files [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
           [catalog=<catalog>] [jobid=<jobid>] [ujobid=<ujobid>] [type=<type>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |
| `type=` | string |  |  |  | File type. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

Every file saved by job 42:

```text
list files jobid=42
```

### list filesets {#sub-list-filesets}

**Every FileSet.**

Lists every FileSet record of the catalog with id, name, MD5 sum, creation time and FileSet text. A FileSet gets a new record whenever its definition changes; current keeps only FileSets still defined in the configuration.

```text
list filesets [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
              [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

All FileSet records of the catalog:

```text
list filesets
```

Only FileSets still present in the configuration:

```text
list filesets current
```

### list fileset {#sub-list-fileset}

**One FileSet.**

Shows one FileSet record of the catalog, including the stored FileSet text and its MD5 sum. The record is selected by filesetid= or by the job that used it with jobid= or ujobid=; without one of them the command reports an error.

```text
list fileset[=<fileset>] [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current]
                        [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>]
                        [filesetid=<filesetid>] [jobid=<jobid>]
                        [ujobid=<ujobid>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fileset=` | resource | from [`.filesets`](../dot-filesets/) |  | value optional | FileSet name. |
| `filesetid=` | integer |  |  |  | FileSet ID. |
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The FileSet used by job 42:

```text
list fileset jobid=42
```

The FileSet record with id 3:

```text
list fileset filesetid=3
```

### list jobs {#sub-list-jobs}

**Jobs.**

Lists the jobs of the catalog, one row per job. The filters can be combined: job= or jobname=, client=, jobstatus= (letters such as T, E, f or names such as error, comma-separated), jobtype= (letter or exact name such as Backup), joblevel= or level= (F, I, D or Full, Incremental, Differential), volume=, pool=, days= and hours=. last keeps only the latest run per job name, count prints just the number of rows, reverse shows the newest first.

limit= and offset= page through the result. For a console with ACLs the limit is applied before the rows the console may not see are removed, so a limited listing can come out shorter or even empty. An unknown jobtype or level is an error.

```text
list jobs [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
          [catalog=<catalog>] [client=<client>] [jobstatus=<jobstatus>[,...]]
          [jobtype=<jobtype>[,...]] [joblevel=<joblevel>[,...]]
          [level=<level>[,...]] [volume=<volume>] [pool=<pool>] [days=<days>]
          [hours=<hours>] [last] [count] [reverse] [job=<job>]
          [jobname=<jobname>] [jobid=<jobid>[,...]] [ujobid=<ujobid>]
          [fileset=<fileset>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name. |
| `jobstatus=` | string |  |  | list | Job status letters. |
| `jobtype=` | string |  |  | list | Job type letters. |
| `joblevel=` | string |  |  | list | Job level letters. |
| `level=` | string |  |  | list | Job level letters. |
| `volume=` | resource | from [`.media`](../dot-media/) |  |  | Volume name. |
| `pool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Pool name. |
| `days=` | integer |  |  |  | Of the last days. |
| `hours=` | integer |  |  |  | Of the last hours. |
| `last` | keyword |  |  |  | Only the last run of each job. |
| `count` | keyword |  |  |  | Only count. |
| `reverse` | keyword |  |  |  | Newest first (Onesimus). |
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Job name. |
| `jobname=` | string |  |  |  | Job name. |
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  | list | Job ID. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |
| `fileset=` | resource | from [`.filesets`](../dot-filesets/) |  |  | FileSet name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The latest run of every job name on bareos-fd:

```text
list jobs client=bareos-fd last
```

Successful full backups of the last 30 days:

```text
list jobs level=Full jobstatus=T days=30
```

The number of jobs in the catalog:

```text
list jobs count
```

### list joblog {#sub-list-joblog}

**Log of a job.**

Prints the stored log of one job with time stamps; jobid= or ujobid= selects the job. count prints only the number of log lines. An unknown JobId or a job the console may not access gives "jobid not found in db, access to job or client denied by ACL, or client not found in db".

```text
list joblog [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
            [catalog=<catalog>] [jobid=<jobid>] [ujobid=<ujobid>] [count]
            [reverse]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |
| `count` | keyword |  |  |  | Only count. |
| `reverse` | keyword |  |  |  | Newest first. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The complete log of job 42:

```text
list joblog jobid=42
```

The number of log lines of job 42:

```text
list joblog jobid=42 count
```

```text
              [catalog=<catalog>] [jobid=<jobid>] [ujobid=<ujobid>]
```

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The volumes written by job 42:

```text
list jobmedia jobid=42
```

### list jobtotals {#sub-list-jobtotals}

**Totals per job name.**

Shows the number of jobs, files and bytes per job name for backup, archive and copy jobs, followed by the totals over all of them. In API mode 2 the rows are under "jobs" and the sums under "jobtotals".

```text
list jobtotals [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current]
               [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

Jobs, files and bytes per job name and in total:

```text
list jobtotals
```

### list jobstatistics {#sub-list-jobstatistics}

**Statistics of a job.**

Aliases: `jobstats`

Lists the statistics samples (sample time, files and bytes) recorded for a running or finished job; jobid= is required. Without it, or for a job the console may not access, the reply is "no jobid given"; a job without statistics gives "No results to list." The alias jobstats is accepted.

```text
list jobstatistics [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current]
                   [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>] [jobid=<jobid>]
                   [job=<job>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Job name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The statistics samples of job 42:

```text
list jobstatistics jobid=42
```

### list log {#sub-list-log}

**Director log.**

Prints the most recent log lines of all jobs from the catalog, by default the last five; limit= changes the number. client= restricts them to jobs of one client, an unknown client gives "invalid client argument". The lines appear oldest first, reverse puts the newest first.

```text
list log [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
         [catalog=<catalog>] [client=<client>] [reverse]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name. |
| `reverse` | keyword |  |  |  | Newest first. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The last 20 log lines of all jobs:

```text
list log limit=20
```

The latest log lines of bareos-fd, newest first:

```text
list log client=bareos-fd reverse
```

### list media {#sub-list-media}

**Volumes.**

Alias of list volumes: without a value it lists the volumes grouped by pool and takes the same keywords all, pool=, jobid= and ujobid=; with a value, media=&lt;name&gt;, it shows that single volume like list volume=.

```text
list media[=<media>] [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current]
                     [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>] [jobid=<jobid>]
                     [ujobid=<ujobid>] [pool=<pool>] [all]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `media=` | resource | from [`.media`](../dot-media/) |  | value optional | Volume name. |
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |
| `pool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Pool name. |
| `all` | keyword |  |  |  | Every pool. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The volumes of the pool Incremental:

```text
list media pool=Incremental
```

One volume by name:

```text
list media=Full-0001
```

### list nextvolume {#sub-list-nextvolume}

**Next volume of a job.**

Aliases: `nextvol`

Shows which volume a job would write next, once for every scheduled run within the coming days; days= sets how many days to look ahead (at most 50, other values are ignored with a warning). Without job= the Director lists the job resources and asks for one; a dot aborts. For jobs that write no volume, such as restore jobs, it reports that no next volume can be found.

Deviation from Bareos: for an unknown job odir reports success, whereas Bareos returns an error. In API mode 2 the result is empty.

```text
list nextvolume [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current]
                [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>] [job=<job>]
                [days=<days>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Job name. |
| `days=` | integer |  |  |  | Days ahead. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The next volume BackupClient1 will use:

```text
list nextvolume job=BackupClient1
```

The next volumes for the runs of the coming week:

```text
list nextvolume job=BackupClient1 days=7
```

### list pools {#sub-list-pools}

**Every pool.**

Lists every pool record of the catalog with id, name, number of volumes, maximum volumes, pool type and label format. llist adds all other fields of the records.

```text
list pools [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
           [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

All pools of the catalog:

```text
list pools
```

| `pool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Pool name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The catalog record of the pool Full:


| `poolid=` | integer |  |  |  | Pool ID. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

### list storages {#sub-list-storages}

**Every storage.**

Lists every storage record of the catalog. current, enabled and disabled restrict the listing to storages still configured or in that state.

```text
list storages [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
              [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

All storages of the catalog:

```text
list storages
```

```text
                       [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

### list volumes {#sub-list-volumes}

**Volumes.**

Lists the volumes of the catalog grouped by pool. all prints them in one table, pool= restricts the listing to one pool, jobid= or ujobid= shows only the names of the volumes a job used, and count prints the number of volumes per pool. media is an alias with the same keywords.

If the pool given with pool= is not in the catalog, the Director lists the defined pools and asks for a selection; a dot aborts. In API mode 2 there is no question and the error is returned directly.

```text
list volumes [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current] [enabled | disabled]
             [catalog=<catalog>] [jobid=<jobid>] [ujobid=<ujobid>]
             [pool=<pool>] [all] [count]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |
| `pool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Pool name. |
| `all` | keyword |  |  |  | Every pool. |
| `count` | keyword |  |  |  | Only count. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The volumes of the pool Full:

```text
list volumes pool=Full
```

All volumes in a single table:

```text
list volumes all
```

The names of the volumes job 42 wrote to:

```text
list volumes jobid=42
```

### list volume {#sub-list-volume}

**One volume.**

Shows exactly one volume by its name, with status, bytes, retention, slot, media type and last write time. volumeid= and mediaid= select it by its media id instead.

```text
list volume=<volume> [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current]
                     [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `volume=` | resource | from [`.media`](../dot-media/) |  |  | Volume name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

The catalog record of Full-0001:

```text
list volume=Full-0001
```

### list schedules {#sub-list-schedules}

**Not a catalog list: answered as unknown keyword (see show schedules).**

Schedules are configuration resources and have no table in the catalog, so like Bareos odir answers "Unknown list keyword: schedules". Use show schedules for the schedule resources and show disabled schedules for the disabled ones.

```text
list schedules [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [current]
               [enabled | disabled] [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Also accepts the arguments of [list](#arguments): `limit`, `offset`, `current`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `catalog`.

Answered with Unknown list keyword, use show disabled schedules instead:

```text
list schedules disabled
```

## Examples

The last run of every job of a client:

```text
list jobs client=fd last
```

The ten newest jobs (Onesimus):

```text
list jobs reverse limit=10
```

Every field of one volume:

```text
llist volume=Full-0001
```

The volumes of the pool Full:

```text
list volumes pool=Full
```

Jobs that failed during the last week:

```text
list jobs jobstatus=E,f days=7
```
